notes.title: Show and Play of SUPER Dr Corona with gamedev
Super Dr Corona Tournament / Music and Chill
notes.notes:
Join your favorite electronic music producers & friends as we partner with the EDM Production subreddit/Discord and the International Live Beat Channel (ILBC) for the first Super Dr Corona playtest tournament!!

In this unique party, the gamers are also music producers and we will be spotlighting their work as we watch them battle for the crown against the head developer himself!

Join hosts 74BIT, ill-esha, Nathaniel Wyvern and raggs and enjoy the music of contestants FriendsCallMeTy, Aimerie, Yip Jason, and httpster. If you are also a music producer, there will be opportunities to submit your tracks LIVE on stream for feedback!!

For more info on our partner communities:
[url=http://discord.gg/edmp]EDMP discord[/url]
